About

While building various online businesses I always struggled to get early feedback on new websites, features or prototypes. I didn’t have a large network, and the user testing platforms were expensive and built for large teams.

Surely there were others like me: bootstrapped solo founders and makers who needed to test early versions of their apps, websites or wireframes. A few weeks later I built and launched an MVP called BetaTesta, aiming simply to pair makers with testers.

It launched on Product Hunt in September 2017 and kept gaining traction. After months of feedback and validation I took the platform down to focus on the next phase, and together with ucreate designed a new brand and launched a new landing page in September 2018.
